item.title: CVE-2026-119757 (critical 9.8): BTCPay Server before 2.4.2, including 2.4.2 release candidates, contains an information disclosure vulnerability
item.description: BTCPay Server before 2.4.2, including 2.4.2 release candidates, contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to retrieve .macaroon credential files for an LND (Lightning Network Daemon) node. item.title: CVE-2026-126812 (critical 9.8): blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4.3.7 contains an insecure default configuration in its Docker Compose examples
item.description: blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4.3.7 contains an insecure default configuration in its Docker Compose examples that sets MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=yes in database.env and publishes MariaDB on port 3306. Unauthenticated attackers reaching the Docker host on port 3306 can log in as root without a password to read, modify, or delete user accounts, blueprints, and all databases.

item.title: CVE-2026-126797 (critical 9.8): NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ns-admin that allows unauthenticated
item.description: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ns-admin that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens using a hardcoded JWT signing key. Attackers can sign an HS256 X-Access-Token carrying the public super administrator role ID to gain full access to user management, scan tasks and stored vulnerability results.

item.title: CVE-2026-126768 (critical 9.8): OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers
item.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain valid JWTs by setting the client-controlled is_local_auth field. Attackers can send a POST /api/v1/user/login/ request for the admin account with an invalid password and is_local_auth true to gain SuperUser administrative access.

item.title: CVE-2026-110697 (critical 9.9): A flaw was found in Quay where the robot account listing function constructs a SQL LIKE pattern from user-controlled
item.description: A flaw was found in Quay where the robot account listing function constructs a SQL LIKE pattern from user-controlled namespace names without escaping wildcard metacharacters. An attacker who creates a namespace containing an underscore character can match and retrieve robot accounts and their decrypted authentication tokens from other tenants' namespaces, leading to cross-tenant credential theft and unauthorized image operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-123710 (critical 9.8): A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay. An unauthenticated client can obtain an anonymous registry token with an audience
item.description: A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay. An unauthenticated client can obtain an anonymous registry token with an audience it controls, present that token to the service key rotation endpoint, and install its own approved signing key with no expiry. Registry tokens signed with that key are accepted for any repository, allowing read and write access to private images and replacement of repository tags.

item.title: CVE-2026-126542 (critical 9.8): WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers
item.description: WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user via Hybridauth social login display names.
